name: The Shoppes at Old Bridge
summary: The Shoppes at Old Bridge is a community shopping center on U.S. Route 9 in Old Bridge, New Jersey, offering convenient access to national retailers and dining options. With a 4.3-star rating and strategic location along a major commercial corridor, it serves as a practical shopping destination for Middlesex County families and commuters.
demographics: The Shoppes at Old Bridge serves a diverse suburban demographic in Middlesex County, New Jersey, primarily attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Old Bridge, Sayreville, and surrounding communities. The trade area consists largely of homeowners aged 30-65 with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, including a significant population of commuters to New York City and northern New Jersey employment centers. Shoppers typically visit for convenient everyday needs, combining grocery shopping with retail errands and casual dining, reflecting the practical shopping patterns of suburban families balancing work and household responsibilities.
description: The Shoppes at Old Bridge is a community shopping center conveniently located on U.S. Route 9 in Old Bridge, New Jersey, serving as a retail hub for Middlesex County residents. This open-air shopping destination provides a practical mix of national retailers, dining options, and service providers that cater to the everyday needs of local families and commuters. With its accessible location along one of New Jersey's major commercial corridors, the center offers ample parking and easy access for shoppers traveling from Old Bridge, Sayreville, East Brunswick, and neighboring communities. The shopping center maintains a solid reputation among local residents, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from nearly 600 reviews, who appreciate its convenient layout and diverse tenant mix. Operating daily from 10 AM to 8 PM, The Shoppes at Old Bridge continues to serve as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination for Central Jersey residents seeking a straightforward retail experience.
